expectations.text: States the timing rule: CE Plus must be completed within 3 months of the basic certification
expectations.evidence: 'the audit must be completed within 3 months of your basic certification date'

expectations.text: Describes the audit content: internal (authenticated) and external vulnerability scans, a random sample of user devices (roughly 10%, covering build types), all internet gateways and internet-reachable servers, plus malware and email/browser download defence tests
expectations.evidence: 'Authenticated internal vulnerability scans... random sample... typically around 10%... cover each distinct build type'; 'External vulnerability scans... all your internet gateways... every server reachable'; 'Malware protection tests'; 'Email and browser download defence tests'

expectations.text: Notes the current retest rules: a failed sample triggers a retest with a NEW random sample, and a second failure revokes the verified self-assessment certificate; answers can't be adjusted once testing begins
expectations.evidence: 'the retest uses an entirely new random sample'; 'if that second sample also fails... revokes your underlying verified self-assessment certificate'; 'once CE+ testing begins, you cannot go back and adjust your self-assessment answers'

expectations.text: Lists realistic failure causes: unpatched high/critical vulnerabilities on sampled devices, missing MFA, local admin misconfigurations, unsupported software discovered in scope
expectations.evidence: 'scan finds a critical/high vulnerability'; 'MFA gaps found on testing'; 'unmanaged local admin account'; 'Unsupported software surviving in the sample'

expectations.text: Notes CE+ is individually quoted (not the fixed basic-tier pricing) and can be remote or on-site
expectations.evidence: Says 'remote or on-site' but never states CE+ is individually quoted rather than fixed-tier pricing
